_meta.name: byzahin.com Chatbot Knowledge Base
_meta.description: First-person AI knowledge base for Zahin Syahiran's interactive chat.
_meta.how_to_edit: Each object in 'intents' is one topic. 'keywords' = words/phrases that trigger it. 'examples' = sample real questions. 'answer' = what the bot replies in first-person.

intents.answer: Hey, thanks for stopping by! I'm Zahin. Ask me about my work experience, skills, past projects, availability for freelance, or how to get in touch. Explore [Services & Rates](/service), view [Projects](/projects), or read [About Me](/about).

I'm Zahin Syahiran, a UI/UX Designer and Brand Strategist based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia with about 8 years of experience spanning graphic design, brand identity, and product/UX design. I'm currently a Senior UI/UX Designer at Gamuda Technologies, focusing on AI-native products, and I also run my own design practice for freelance and consultancy work. Read more on the [About Page](/about) or connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zahinsyahiran/).

I'm currently a Senior UI/UX Designer at Gamuda Technologies, working on AI-focused product design. Before this, I built my experience across MoneyX, Borong Malaysia, PolicyStreet, Fixcolab, and Paperballad. Learn more about my journey on the [About Page](/about).

I have ~8 years of experience across graphic design, branding, and product/UX (including 5+ years in FinTech, InsurTech, and B2B SaaS). I founded Designloka (Malaysia's first subscription-based graphic design service) in 2019 while studying at Saito University College, then worked with MoneyX, Borong Malaysia, PolicyStreet, Fixcolab, and Paperballad, and am now Senior UI/UX Designer at Gamuda Technologies. Explore my background on the [About Page](/about) or contact me directly via [Contact](/contact).

examples: Did you run your own business?
intents.answer: Designloka was my own venture — Malaysia's first subscription-based graphic design service, founded in 2019 while I was still studying. I ran it solo-to-small-team, handling business development, finance, and delivery, working with clients including IPG Mediabrands accounts and Grain Singapore. Read more about my journey on the [About Page](/about).

quickReplies.label: What services do you offer now?

intents.answer: I hold an Honours degree in Graphic Design from Saito University College (2024). Read more about my background on the [About Page](/about).

My core strengths: UI/UX design, design systems, brand identity, and product design. Tools I use include Figma (primary), Adobe Creative Cloud, plus AI-assisted / vibe-coding tools like Lovable, Antigravity, Cursor, ChatGPT, and Aura.build for rapid prototyping and shipping AI-native web builds. See these tools in action across my [Projects](/projects).

I offer UI/UX design, brand identity systems, website development, and design consultancy. Key services include Website Design & Development (RM5,300 for up to 7 pages with GEO setup & Google Antigravity dev), Brand Identity Packages (RM1,000–RM3,000), Logo Design (RM800), UI Design (RM450/page), and Social Media Visuals (RM110/visual). Explore full details on the [Services Page](/service).

examples: What's the budget for a project?
intents.answer: My rates range from RM110 per visual for social media design, RM150 for business cards, RM450/page for UI design, RM800 for logo design, up to RM5,300 for full website design & development with GEO setup. View my complete rate breakdown on the [Services Page](/service) or get in touch via [Contact](/contact).

examples: How does a project usually go?
intents.answer: My design process: 1. Understand the problem (stakeholder alignment & success metrics) → 2. Research & competitive benchmarking → 3. Ideation & flow sketching → 4. Hi-fi prototyping in Figma → 5. Usability testing & validation → 6. Developer handoff & iteration. Learn more on the [Services Page](/service).

I work full-time at Gamuda Technologies but take on select freelance and consultancy projects outside of work hours. Contact me via [Contact Page](/contact), email (muhammadzahien@gmail.com), or [WhatsApp](http://wasap.my/60183943519) with your project scope and timeline.

My recent project highlights include: Great Eastern Takaful (customer experience rearchitecture), MoneyX App (FinTech savings goals & referral design), PolicyStreet (InsurTech marketplace), Knock Knock Cafe (branding & art direction), and active side projects like Medigo (AI medical tourism marketplace). Explore all case studies on the [Projects Page](/projects).

examples: Tell me about the MoneyX project
What did you do at MoneyX?
intents.answer: At MoneyX, I designed key mobile app features including the Savings Goals manual entry flows, category selection, transaction edits, and the user acquisition Referral Program dashboard. Read the full case study on the [MoneyX Project Page](/projects/moneyx-savings-goals-manual-entry).

examples: Tell me about Knock Knock Cafe
intents.answer: Knock Knock Cafe is a branding and art direction project I did in Kuala Terengganu, covering logo design, coffee packaging, merchandise, and storefront aesthetics. Read the full case study on the [Knock Knock Cafe Page](/projects/knock-knock-cafe-kuala-terengganu).

Medigo is my in-progress AI-powered medical tourism marketplace connecting patients with verified clinics across Malaysia, built using Lovable, Cursor, and ChatGPT. Explore all builds on the [Projects Page](/projects).

examples: Tell me about the Flaaah project
intents.answer: I am leading the brand creative direction for Flaaah (flaaah.com), treating visual execution as a core business strategy to align their brand identity with their next stage of growth. Read the article in [Journals](/journals).

examples: Do you write about your process?
Where can I read your journals?
intents.answer: I document project announcements, design thoughts, and process notes in my Journals section — including articles on Flaaah's creative direction and platform updates. Read the articles on the [Journals Page](/journals).

examples: When could you start a new role?
intents.answer: I have a standard 1 to 2 month notice period at my current role, but am open to discussing timelines for the right full-time product design opportunity. Reach out via the [Contact Page](/contact).

keywords: how did you get into design
examples: How did you get into UX design?
Why did you choose this career?
intents.answer: I started in graphic design and branding, then moved into product/UX as I got more involved in building full digital products — running Designloka gave me early exposure to both creative and business sides. Read more career FAQs on the [FAQ Page](/faq).

examples: Are you open to remote work?
intents.answer: I'm open to hybrid or remote arrangements in the Kuala Lumpur / Selangor area for full-time roles, and fully remote or flexible arrangements for freelance/consultancy projects. Read more on the [FAQ Page](/faq).
I am based in Kuala Lumpur / Selangor, Malaysia (GMT+8). Get in touch via the [Contact Page](/contact).
